name: wodlab
description: Mobile-first workout tracking and coaching platform

scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.check:api: pnpm --dir apps/api lint:check && pnpm --dir apps/api test --runInBand && pnpm --dir apps/api build
scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/api lint:check && pnpm --dir apps/web lint
